limits: Authoring Full accounts for original source duties with explicit local game/resource/material protocols, not observed attainment or universal knowledge of every sport.

Existing hard paths remain exact, including rule vocabulary, empathy vocabulary and goal-setting support. No additional graph cleanup is proposed; source task duties are not expanded by treating those complete cards as universal NCERT mandates.

Game instructions use the complete existing spoken instruction/clarification/listening operation and appropriate understood language; no all-language proficiency or fixed national language pair is inferred.
No compulsory injury, emotional distress, private disclosure, positive feeling, fitness improvement or quantitative distance/height benchmark is manufactured.
scopeDecision: User excludes Physical Education. Current record dispositions override dated full-scope review; all source identities remain catalogued. Fine-motor, sensory, health and genuine artistic operations remain in scope.
